product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides customizable dental practice management software for dental practices of any size or specialty, covering scheduling, patient records, charting, billing, and communications.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains product, practice-management, release, and employee-interview content; the reviewed material does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public user documentation links to numerous articles covering setup, security, modules, and administration.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active openings are Dental Assistant/Software Support and Daycare Aide; no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title is listed.

model_provider.value: Pearl (Second Opinion), BetterDiagnostics, and Bola AI (Voice Assist)
model_provider.notes: These are explicitly documented third-party AI integrations, not a disclosure of an underlying foundation model or LLM provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Public HIPAA compliance claim: Open Dental says it follows HIPAA security/privacy standards and uses HIPAA-compliant, encrypted support-data transit. This is a compliance claim, not an independently issued HIPAA certification.

last_funding.notes: Owler records an April 2020 PPP debt round. The SBA-derived loan record gives the exact approved amount and April 6, 2020 approval date. Tracxn describes the company as unfunded; that description does not capture this PPP loan. No equity financing was identified.

raised_18mo.notes: For 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09: the only identified financing is the April 2020 PPP loan; Tracxn reports no funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither active opening is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 26.2 became stable on 2026-11-03, within the 2026-05-09–2026-11-09 window. Its major new Glidewell integration enables electronic lab-case submission for Medit and iTero scanners, including Open Dental Cloud.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete, checkable executive roster or dated C-level/VP join/departure evidence was found for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Integration signals only, not verified internal use by Open Dental employees: Mailchimp powers the documented Mass Email integration; SmartSync lists GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Salesforce as CRM destinations for Open Dental customer data.
